title: New 1.5 Miles to Broadway | City Views | Game Room
description:
Brand-new Nashville dream home with STUNNING top-level patio city views! Game room featuring foosball & arcade, plus fully-equipped kitchen! Just 1.5 miles to Broadway/Ryman, half mile to Germantown's upscale gems like City House & 5th & Taylor, plus Nashville's huge Farmer's Market! Gated community retreat perfectly central to ALL Music City magic!

The space
Please note that there is a Gate around the entire complex (code will be given with checkin instructions).
